system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Perform these two different actions simultaneously: horti_get_pest_advisory and horti_update_crop_stage.. my new_stage is dummy_new_stage_3441, my crop_type is dummy_crop_type_8645, my location is dummy_location_9267, my crop_stage is None.

function.name: horti_update_crop_stage
function.description: Manually updates the crop stage for personalized tracking. Requires session_token. Does NOT generate advisory — use horti_get_stage_advisory. Fails if stage transition is invalid (e.g., jumping from sowing to harvesting) or session invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for personalized advisory tools.

new_stage.description: New stage. Must follow valid progression.

function.name: horti_get_pest_advisory
function.description: Provides pest and disease management advisory for a horticulture crop at a specific stage. Includes prevention, identification, and treatment guidance. PUBLIC tool. Does NOT diagnose specific infestations — it provides general recommendations. Fails if crop-stage mismatch or no pest data available.
